job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




What youll be doing

Collaborate & Innovate: Partner with Technical Architects, Engagement Managers and Product teams to define customer requirements/use cases, facilitate technical workshops, and co-create specific GenAI solutions.
Prototype Rapidly: Apply an AI-first experimentation mindset—build proof points in days, iterate on feedback, and drive quick wins. UX/UI and rapid prototyping skills are a plus.
Engineer End-to-End: Design, build, and deploy full-stack applications and microservices—integrating Firefly APIs, Common Extensibility Platform, GenStudio for Performance Marketing, headless CMS architectures and UX/UI Designs.
Bridge to Product: Capture field-proven use cases and funnel them back to Product & Engineering—fueling the Firefly roadmap.
Automate & Scale: Develop reusable components, CI/CD pipelines, and governance checks to ensure consistent, repeatable delivery.
Operate at Speed: Thrive in a constantly evolving, start-up-like environment—own delivery sprints, tackle challenges on-site/remotely, and adapt to evolving AI trends.
Share & Elevate: Document your playbooks, prompts, and patterns in our internal knowledge base—helping the whole organization move faster.



Key Responsibilities

Design, configure, and optimize customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer.
Build and manage omnichannel campaigns across email, mobile, and web experiences.
Develop and maintain workflows, decisioning rules, and real-time customer profiles.
Integrate AJO with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and other Adobe Experience Cloud tools.
Troubleshoot platform, workflow, and integration issues to ensure seamless operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design scalable, insight-driven solutions.
Optimize campaign performance through data-driven analysis.
Maintain documentation, operational playbooks, and best practices.


Required Skills & Qualifications
4–6 years of hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer.
6+ years overall experience in application development or MarTech engineering.
Strong understanding of customer journey orchestration and real-time customer data.
Experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), schemas, segments, and datasets.
Proficiency in API integrations and cross-platform data flows.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.
